resources.string: This screen reads the ECU coding and vehicle order data (FA, FG, AIF, ZIF) and saves a copy you can export and compare with earlier reads. It never writes or restores anything: real coding needs the NCS Expert data files, which the app does not ship, and wrong coding can leave the ECU unusable.\n\nIf you really need to write coding, do it on purpose from the list of all jobs. There every write asks for a red confirmation and warns when the battery is low, and before clearing faults the app saves an automatic copy of the fault memory.
%1$s has no jobs that read coding or vehicle order data.
The copy could not be saved on the phone. You can still share it as CSV.
The job did not finish correctly, so no copy is saved.
Read the coding first or open a saved copy.
There is no earlier copy of %1$s / %2$s to compare with.
